'''Miser''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Most of the metal that was used in the production of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] came from the hot planet, which had a core of mostly [[Iron/Legends|iron]] and [[gententhium]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], the creator of Cloud City, sketched out a plan for a rolling mining center that could stay permanently out of direct sunlight on Miser's dark side, but the idea was never followed up. Miser's terrain was too rough for something on wheels to move easily.<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The planet was also the location of a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Grendreef/Legends|Grendreef]], and protected by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']].<ref name="TIC">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]''</ref>
